# CoreDNS Internal Cluster DNS & Latency Tuning

Kubernetes internal DNS tuning: CoreDNS autopath optimization, ndots:5 avoidance, caching plugins, and fallback forwarders.

## Invariants
- ENABLE_COREDNS_CACHE_PLUGIN_WITH_TTL
- OPTIMIZE_CLIENT_NDOTS_TO_AVOID_DNS_FLOODING
- AUTOPATH_FOR_SEARCH_PATH_REDUCTION
